title: Choose a chunk size
summary: What happens when chunks are too small or too large.

choices.text: Very small chunks can lose the context needed to interpret them, such as which product a sentence is about.
Chunk size does not matter once a re-ranker is used.
Very large chunks dilute the embedding across several topics and spend the context window on irrelevant text.
Prepending the document title and section headings to each chunk helps both retrieval and the model's reading.
The best chunk size is always the model's full context window, so each document is one chunk.
